verdict.rationale: The portal has no native user-defined automation feature, so background automation is only approximated. It offers 'Email notifications' and email-update subscriptions, which are passive alerts that run in the background once configured. A keyless JSON business-entities data API, verified by probe, lets users build their own scheduled automations with external tools. Missing for 10: native configurable automations or scheduled tasks (e.g., auto-filing or auto-renewal of periodic reports), any documentation of how notifications are triggered or configured, and independent corroboration of autonomous background operation.
